tasks.title: Adversarial retest of theory THEORY-00001
tasks.objective: Resolve the scientific challenge affecting "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" through independent and adversarial evidence.
tasks.hypothesis: "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" should remain scientifically defensible when tested against independent implementations, counterexamples, and adversarial evidence.
tasks.supportCondition: The retested scientific claim is supported when independent executable evidence reproducibly confirms behavior consistent with the hypothesis.
tasks.challengeCondition: The retested scientific claim is challenged when independent executable evidence reproducibly demonstrates behavior incompatible with the hypothesis.
procedure: Select at least one independent source not responsible for the original evidence.
Ingest and normalize the selected source through the OECL source pipeline.
Search for independent implementations that do not exhibit the claimed relationship.
Search for direct counterexamples in executable code, tests, or invariants.
Compare supporting evidence against contradictory or alternative behavior.
Recalculate scientific confidence after introducing adversarial evidence.
Attempt to construct a valid protocol composition in which the theory does not hold.
Regenerate relevant evidence and scientific assessments.
Run scientific self-critique again for the target.
Generate a new scientific revision decision.
Compare the new revision with the revision that triggered this retest.
requiredEvidence: At least one independent implementation source.
Direct implementation, executable test, or invariant evidence.
Traceable evidence linked to the target statement.
At least one adversarial test designed specifically to falsify the theory.
successCriteria: At least one new independent evidence source is introduced.
The target receives new directly relevant evidence.
The scientific assessment changes or receives stronger reproducible justification.
The target survives or fails an explicit adversarial retest.
failureCriteria: No independent implementation can be evaluated.
The experiment produces no directly relevant evidence.
The result cannot be reproduced or traced to source evidence.
tasks.explanation: The experiment has sufficient planning metadata to be handed to a future execution runtime.

tasks.title: Validate Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory
tasks.objective: Collect sufficient independent evidence to determine whether "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" should be validated or rejected.
tasks.hypothesis: "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" predicts that independent executable evidence will reproduce the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
tasks.supportCondition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is supported when an executable assertion demonstrates behavior consistent with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
tasks.challengeCondition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is challenged when an executable assertion reproduces a counterexample incompatible with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".

support.condition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is supported when an executable assertion demonstrates behavior consistent with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".

challenge.condition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is challenged when an executable assertion reproduces a counterexample incompatible with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".

procedure: Select one repository not currently included in the supporting evidence.
Ingest and normalize the selected repository.
Extract protocols, capabilities, claims, tests, and invariants.
Regenerate the cross-source evidence graph.
Search for executable assertions that support or challenge the relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
Recalculate confidence, contradictions, and scientific validation.
Compare the new validation result with the previous result.
requiredEvidence: At least one independent implementation source.
Direct executable evidence supporting or challenging the relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
Evidence from a repository not currently responsible for the theory.
successCriteria: At least one new directly relevant evidence edge is discovered.
Validation score changes by at least 5 points.
The experiment produces a reproducible result.
failureCriteria: The selected repository duplicates existing evidence without increasing diversity.
The evidence cannot be reproduced or traced to its source.
tasks.explanation: The experiment has sufficient planning metadata to be handed to a future execution runtime.

tasks.title: Investigate knowledge gap GAP-00001
tasks.objective: Low-confidence conclusion: Reservation appears to constrain Accounting across 2 observed source identities.
tasks.hypothesis: Additional independent evidence can reduce uncertainty associated with: Low-confidence conclusion: Reservation appears to constrain Accounting across 2 observed source identities.
tasks.supportCondition: The knowledge gap is reduced when new independent executable evidence provides reproducible information directly relevant to the unresolved scientific statement.
tasks.challengeCondition: The knowledge gap remains or increases when new executable evidence contradicts the unresolved statement or exposes additional uncertainty that prevents deterministic resolution.
procedure: Select a repository relevant to the gap.
Ingest the repository through the OECL GitHub ingestor.
Extract direct and indirect evidence related to the gap.
Rebuild conclusions and confidence assessments.
Check whether the gap remains, weakens, or is resolved.
successCriteria: The associated confidence score increases or decreases meaningfully.
The gap receives a clear resolved or unresolved classification.
tasks.explanation: The experiment has sufficient planning metadata to be handed to a future execution runtime.
